journal.isekai_mahou.dwarf_hold.enter.hi: It lies in the deepslate (y ≈ −45). The south gate collapsed: dig through the rubble or come in from a cave.
journal.isekai_mahou.dwarf_hold.enter.lo: The stone gate still stands. The portcullis was never lowered.
journal.isekai_mahou.dwarf_hold.intro: They say the dwarves never left. They just dug deeper than anyone dared to follow.
journal.isekai_mahou.dwarf_hold.lore: Far below the deepslate, around y −45, lie stone halls no map shows. Mithril is still forged there — and runes still engraved.
Only in deepslate, below y 0 (most common near y −48). Iron pickaxe or better. The city's Old Mines still have a few veins.
Lighter than steel, harder than diamond, and it sings when it meets a rune.
journal.isekai_mahou.dwarf_hold.outro: You traded with the dwarves and carry their runes. To a dwarf, that's almost family.
journal.isekai_mahou.dwarf_hold.rune: Engrave a rune at the Rune Forge
journal.isekai_mahou.dwarf_hold.rune.hin: Main hand: the piece. Off hand: an Essence (each essence is a rune). Costs 2 Mithril Ingots and 3 levels. Click empty-handed to see every rune.
journal.isekai_mahou.dwarf_hold.rune.lor: A rune is no ornament. It's a promise carved in metal.
journal.isekai_mahou.dwarf_hold.title: The Lost Dwarven City
journal.isekai_mahou.dwarf_hold.trade.hi: The Merchant is in the market (west wing); the Smith, in the forge (east wing). Dwarf-race players get a discount.
journal.isekai_mahou.dwarf_hold.trade.lo: Dwarves never forget a good customer. Or a bad one.
journal.isekai_mahou.dwarf_hold.treasure: The Hero's Shield and the Appraisal Monocle can be found in the Sealed Vault (iron door behind the throne — beware its guardians) or bought from the dwarves at a steep price.
The king kept there what not even dwarves could forge twice.
message.isekai_mahou.dwarf_hold.forge.he: Main hand: weapon, armor, shield or tool. Off hand: an Essence. Cost: %s Mithril Ingots and %s levels. One rune per piece (engraving another replaces it).
message.isekai_mahou.dwarf_hold.forge.ne: Hold an Essence in your off hand to choose the rune.
message.isekai_mahou.dwarf_hold.forge.re: The old rune fades... %s engraved on %s!
message.isekai_mahou.dwarf_hold.found.su: You found the Lost Dwarven City! Look for the Merchant, the Smith and the Rune Forge.
message.isekai_mahou.dwarf_hold.greet.me: "Mithril, essences, rare things... everything has a price, outsider."
message.isekai_mahou.dwarf_hold.greet.sm: "Bring me Mithril and I'll make it a legend."
message.isekai_mahou.dwarf_hold.hit: "Hey! Save that steel for the monsters!"
message.isekai_mahou.dwarf_hold.kin: "A kinsman of the mountain! Family prices for you." (−25%)

tooltip.isekai_mahou.dwarf_hold.hero_shi: "I don't attack. I protect — and give it back."
